name: 露耳收鬓
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone square head-and-upper-chest portrait, part of a six-option Chinese xianxia female FRONT-HAIR exploration. Draw one woman only, no grids, no comparison panels, no lettering.
User's latest direction: earlier options ALL had two long locks hanging beside both cheeks and were unsatisfactory. Explore different front-hair structures and how they reveal ears, cheeks and jaw. The design below overrides the hairstyle in the references.
References: Image 1 female_active.png is ONLY the original project's fine gongbi/light-watercolor illustration style, adult anatomy, warm pale ivory-peach complexion, gently oval face silhouette, neck and blue-gray/ivory crossed-collar floral/cloud robe reference. Image 2 front_hair_exploration_v3.png supports the illustration quality and portrait crop; its repeated paired long cheek locks are REJECTED. Do not copy those long front locks.
Framing: one strictly front-facing adult Chinese woman, complete top of hair through upper chest, head-to-shoulder proportions natural like the references, straight forward gaze, level eyes, relaxed shoulders, centered with generous margin above hair. Plain pale warm ivory backdrop, soft even diffuse light, no scenery. Fine natural facial features and soft complete nose including bridge, alae and nostrils, restrained lashes, natural pale peach lips, no glossy makeup, no giant eyes or childlike face. Preserve project's underlying face outline and skin tone.
Hair rendering: deep warm charcoal-black, extremely fine gongbi strands inside coherent naturally tapered hair groups, matte ink shading with restrained warm-gray highlights. Believable close-fitting scalp, no inflated helmet volume, soft organic asymmetry. Minimal deliberate fine flyaways, not scribbles. No silver or brown recolor, no plastic grooves or white rim light.
Mandatory: implement the specific hair-root, forehead, temple and end-length design below. Do not add a pair of long side locks to 'balance' it. Where temples are described as tucked or swept back, keep cheek and neck skin unobscured; the long hair is actually gathered behind the head and MUST NOT sneak forward as two shoulder/chest curtains. Full ears remain natural and attached, hair overlaps naturally rather than cutting ear-shaped holes.
Avoid all-over glossy hair, photorealism, 3D, anime, cartoon, heavy blunt bangs, Dora/bowl/bob haircut, rigid horizontal fringe, thick black curtain covering eyes, narrow wire-only bangs, symmetrical long cheek tendrils, extra jewelry, weapons, text, watermarks.
Specific new design: Natural soft swept-back crown with a small irregular forehead opening, only TWO or THREE SHORT tapered wisps at the forehead hairline, tips stay ABOVE eyebrows. BOTH temples gather snugly BACK BEHIND BOTH EARS into a compact high ponytail tied behind the crown with a plain dark tie; the tail stays entirely behind head/neck, not over chest. FULL cheeks, jaw corners, earlobes and sides of neck are clearly visible with NO hanging side hair. Adult capable calm appearance, naturally medium straight brows and quietly defined long eyes. Ordinary scalp lies close to skull, high tail is a separate rear form. This is an elegant open-ear, cheek-clean silhouette, not a severe waxed-back style.
